notes: The italicized 'even' before 'to us' is `added` under rule 105, no expressed preposition standing to carry the appositive — the supplied 'to' is a case preposition on ἡμῖν — and the verse is analysed consistently with 10:38.
οὐ keeps 'not' since the clause has no negative indefinite; τοῖς after μάρτυσι is `unrepresented` under rule 31 with the relativizer on the participle.
